title: Save four ADDs in an actual BIT shared-source packet
body:
## Summary

An exact factorization of one frozen R438 prelude reduces 13 ADDs to 9. The complete word uses **36,001 instead of 36,005 ADDs**, preserving all 2,913 recursive queries, rank mass 5,101, nine COPY/ERASE episodes and the original expanded cleanup.

This revision also fixes the independent verifier's initialization of prefix metrics for a supplied nonidentity state and directly checks both inverse composition orders for every compared word. A focused regression reproduces the old undercount. All previously reported mathematical receipt fields and prefix values are unchanged.

## Scope and limits

The two original queries act on distinct helper registers and commute as whole-register operations. Their **address projectors** do not commute: `(PQ-QP)[0,1]=1/8`. The revised prose makes this distinction and the scalar rewrite's entering cut explicit.

Source-only tours cannot transform the independent helper dirt required by the frozen interface. The displayed exact repair adds four rank-two queries; this is its invoice, not an optimal-repair or general noncommuting lower bound. The scalar saving has zero recursive-query moment delta. The public shear is Boolean; the signed lift preserves inherited even dirty-target terms.

Only `research/bit-shared-source-compensation/` changes. The user-assigned scope differs from the pinned `bit-new-register-model` card, as documented in TASK.json. Scientific base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`. No new κ, native supplier admission, all-size precision theorem, selected-frontier change or formal-kernel proof is claimed. [Proof, receipts and open questions](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/tree/5a34918402ae2c0c683d8820ad832970e77f6382/research/bit-shared-source-compensation).

## Test plan

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-shared-source-compensation
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/bit-shared-source-compensation --check-source-history
```

Registered normal and optimized Python 3.12.12 replay, committed-byte/source-history checks, and the official export integrity check pass locally. Only this package is selected for replay. Hosted [Registered research packages CI](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39259134600) **passed** on revision `5a34918402ae2c0c683d8820ad832970e77f6382`, including both registered modes and the unchanged-input check.

The replay covers all 660 independent integer columns, actual frame projectors, delivery cuts, COPY/ERASE equality guards, both inverse orders, complete invoices and defect controls. Fresh separate algebra and verifier reviews found no remaining scoped defect; they also independently checked the nine-role scalar identity and the published prefix maxima. This is AI implementation review, not independent human review.

## Sources and credit

The bundled WORD and GEOMETRY archives match [#4021](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4021) at `c01f97ecfc7fa64847f6abd8f7b231e1df8c7b70` byte for byte. Retain Ali Romman's R438/#1043, Sagar Thakrar's transport and hosting lineage, cheesegrader's #540 framework, #589/#1023 hosting and the controller contributors in SOURCE-NOTES.md.

Hanson Sun's [#1522](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1522), building on Ross Richardson/#953 and Wentao Li/#840, already supplies additive-output source tours; the present dirty-helper obstruction does not refute that interface. Chris R / Clear1nsight's [#4005](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4005) concerns a different R437 carrier-deletion quotient. Exact pins, attribution and the dated overlap search's limits are retained in the package; no novelty certificate is claimed.

New work by Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, implementation, writing and separate AI review. Apache-2.0.
